official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
3Dstudio.co AI Render Studio turns a screenshot of a 3D model view, a sketch or an existing render into a photorealistic architectural image. It is made for architects, interior designers and 3D modellers who need a client-ready picture of a design without setting up a render scene.

What you can do in the chat:
• Render a screenshot of your model from SketchUp, Revit, Archicad, Rhino or similar. Attach the picture in ChatGPT, or give a public image link.
• Choose a look (exterior, interior or landscape), Standard or HD quality, and add a short note such as "light brick facade".
• Change a finished render by describing the change, for example "add plants around the house" or "make the roof dark metal".
• Relight a render at dusk, golden hour, night, overcast, winter, summer or rain.
• Find your earlier renders and check your credit balance.

How it works: the render aims to keep the building's shape, camera and proportions from your picture. Every result reports a Model kept score from 0 to 100 that measures how closely it did, and a render with a low score can be re-run once without using credits. The result appears in the chat with a before and after slider. Every render is also saved in My renders at app.3dstudio.co, where you can fix a single area with a brush and share renders with clients.

Before you connect: you need an AI Render Studio account, and you sign in with email or Google when you connect. Renders, changes and relights use the credits already on your account, and a render that fails is not charged. Pictures must be JPG, PNG or WebP under 10 MB. A render takes 20 to 120 seconds, and each account has an hourly limit. The picture is required: the plugin does not create images from text alone.

Made by 3Dstudio.co, an architectural visualization studio with 1,200+ projects since 2013.
